approvedNativeFallbacks.branching.fork: codex-acp 1.6.2 advertises no fork method or extension; keep native Codex as the owner for workflows requiring fork.
approvedNativeFallbacks.branching.hardRollback: codex-acp 1.6.2 advertises no rollback or file-rewind contract; keep native Codex to avoid ambiguous transcript and filesystem semantics.
approvedNativeFallbacks.management.mcpStatus: ACP mcpCapabilities describe server transport accepted at session creation, not host MCP status or management APIs.
approvedNativeFallbacks.management.skills: codex-acp 1.6.2 exposes no skills management method.
approvedNativeFallbacks.management.hooks: codex-acp 1.6.2 exposes no hooks management or hook event method.
approvedNativeFallbacks.management.hookTrust: codex-acp 1.6.2 exposes no hook trust method.
approvedNativeFallbacks.management.hostConfigFiles: codex-acp 1.6.2 exposes no host config archive or edit method.
approvedNativeFallbacks.structuredQuestionsAndMcpElicitation: Standard ACP permission is mapped; Codex-native structured question and MCP elicitation requests remain native until a negotiated ACP request contract exists.
approvedNativeFallbacks.fastServiceTierMetadata: Fast mode is acknowledged through session config and subsequent usage is observed, but ACP does not expose provider billing tier metadata.

deferredToLaterPhase.sessions.importLocal: Phase 5 will build capability-based adopt/import from session list, load, cwd, stable ID, and usable history.
